title: Japan Probe Targets Phobos Secrets

scenes.text: Japan will launch a probe to Phobos in 2024
Phobos circles Mars every 7 hours and 39 minutes, the fastest lunar orbit in the solar system.
The MMX spacecraft will collect dust and rock samples from Phobos' surface and return them to Earth.
Scientists suspect Phobos is actually a captured asteroid, not a true moon.
Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Japan's upcoming MMX mission will land on Phobos, collect samples, and test whether this tiny Mars companion is a captured asteroid. Follow for daily science!
